name: Portfolio Manager
description: Owns investment portfolio construction and management within the Finance & Investments value stream, selecting securities, rebalancing, and running allocation optimization against target weights. Monitors investment guideline compliance and counterparty exposure, drives asset-liability management by measuring duration gaps and projecting liability cash flows, and delivers investment performance reporting to the CFO, ALCO, and committee.

name: Portfolio UW Manager
description: Oversees the underwriting portfolio across appetite guideline management, policy binding, and mid-term endorsement processing. Administers the reinsurance program, screening treaties for retention, referring over-retention cases, and submitting quarterly bordereaux to treaty reinsurers. Monitors portfolio concentration, tracks appetite exceptions, drives underwriting quality assurance, and reports portfolio and appetite status to committee.

name: Premium Auditor
description: Performs financial audit and reconciliation work across the Finance & Investments value stream, supporting financial statement preparation, reserve setting, and financial examination management. Reconciles claims data and ALAE actuals against accruals, prepares statutory reserve schedules and segment footnote disclosures, and supports actuarial data quality and capital instruments management using the general ledger and data warehouse.

name: Pricing Actuary
description: Owns rate indication analysis and rate filings within the Actuarial value stream, calculating indicated rate changes, documenting rate indication memoranda, and assembling filing exhibit packages. Develops predictive rating models, calibrates underwriting guidelines and referral thresholds against the bound book, prices reinsurance treaties, and refreshes expense and commission assumptions on actuarial modeling platforms.

name: Privacy Counsel
description: Leads privacy and corporate governance legal work within the Legal & Corporate Governance value stream, covering board meeting planning, board evaluation, and legal entity administration. Manages regulatory filings and secretarial filings, responding to regulator objection letters and negotiating resolutions with the DOI, and oversees vendor data processing governance, political contributions compliance, and contract financial obligations.

name: Privacy Officer
description: Oversees privacy compliance within the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, driving compliance testing, regulatory change management, and market conduct examination support. Manages control deficiency remediation by validating closure evidence and re-testing remediated controls, monitors key risk indicators and reconciles data anomalies with owners, and maintains regulatory conduct filings through the GRC platform.

name: Process Improvement Specialist
description: Leads process improvement across Corporate Operations, identifying performance gaps, investigating root causes, and configuring operational dashboards. Supports workforce capacity planning by monitoring real-time workload against staffing and triggering queue load-balancing, manages vendor service remediation plans to resolution, and assigns regulatory change implementations to owners while updating operating documents and responding to examination requests.

name: Processing Clerk
description: Performs high-volume transaction processing across Business Operations, spanning policy issuance, renewals, cancellations, and term conversion processing. Conducts annuity application good-order and suitability reviews, handles plan installation and nondiscrimination testing including corrective distributions, scrubs annual census data from sponsors, resolves ambiguous beneficiary designations, and works primarily in the policy administration and billing platforms.

name: Procurement Manager
description: Coordinates business resilience and vendor governance within the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, owning BCM testing, business impact analysis, and BCM programme governance. Schedules and documents resilience tests across critical services, raises and tracks remediation actions, maintains the vulnerability register, and supports IT disaster recovery planning, incident response governance, and crisis communications reviews.

name: Procurement Specialist
description: Performs sourcing and procurement operations within the Finance & Investments value stream, defining sourcing specifications, scoring vendor responses, and running TCO and savings analyses. Manages vendor onboarding with tax and banking verification under maker-checker controls, enforces spend authority limits on purchase orders, verifies invoices against contracted rates, and publishes spend analytics and procurement KPI dashboards.

name: Producer Compliance Manager
description: Oversees producer governance within the Sales, Distribution & Marketing value stream, administering agency and broker relationship governance and delegated authority oversight. Monitors and escalates corrective actions, obtains compliance sign-off on partner materials, and enforces marketing governance standards. Supports producer pipeline reporting, producer training, and retention and cross-sell analytics through the CRM and GRC platforms.

name: Producer Licensing Coordinator
description: Coordinates producer governance activities within the Sales, Distribution & Marketing value stream, supporting agency and broker relationship governance and delegated authority oversight. Investigates agents flagged above conduct thresholds and documents findings, tracks corrective actions to completion with escalation of overdue items, secures compliance sign-off on partner materials, and maintains pipeline records and producer training support in the CRM.

name: Product / Filing Actuary
description: Owns reserve development monitoring and prior-year development analysis within the Actuarial value stream, constructing actuarial triangles and benchmarking tail factor selections against industry schedules. Prepares Board actuarial reporting and supports the statutory actuarial opinion, responding to Audit Committee questions, updating ceded loss estimates each reserve cycle, and incorporating stress outcomes into ORSA and ICAAP.
